universe_selection.method: Rank the predeclared BTCIDR/ETHIDR/XRPIDR candidate set by total close*base-volume IDR notional during the first 30 days of the requested backtest period; retain all three.
universe_selection.survivorship_note: This fixed three-pair candidate set is not a historical archive of all Indodax listings. Delisted pairs are not represented; this limitation must be stated when interpreting results.
